original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Named residual subproblem of the selected #1094 packing: the 4,866 unhosted, non-owner idle rank-48 children of the frozen idle remainder (1,792 replica/port groups). (1) exact price ceiling over every within-group repartition of their axes with ranks <= 51; (2) independent recount of PR1252 pair-class maximum; (3) exact optimum and explicit overlay for the disjoint-star class under the per-axis PR1252 commuting rule.
scope_change_reason: Refined from the generic card to one residual subproblem opened by PR1252 (its two open next questions: independent matching reproduction and coordinated multi-child moves). Uses the card's second method: exact relaxation plus exact optimum on a named class.
bottleneck_link: Complex supplier binds. Repartitioning idle rank-48 children changes the paid histogram (not just scalar counts), so it moves the exact complex endpoint; the ceiling shows this whole route is worth at most +0.000000491646 in kappa over #1094, about 3.4% of the PR1240 fixed-word packing headroom (0.0016872026).
stop_rule: Stop after the class ceiling, the exact star optimum and a structural verifier; do not attempt controller/invoice/assembly admission for the star overlay in this session.
evidence: RESULT.json (exact prices of baseline, PR1252 pair class, star optimum, relaxation ceiling; 4 random repartition controls), STAR-MOVES.json.gz (2,357 explicit moves), STAR-AUDIT.json (independent verifier, 7/7 mutation controls rejected).
author: Guéorgui Maissouradze / PatatePatatePatate
ai_assistance: Substantial Claude (Anthropic, Claude Code, Opus 5.5) assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and documentation; directed in a donated session.

open_questions.question: Does the 2,357-move star overlay pass the serialized controller/owner audit, the mixed-provider invoice and the strict global assembly that admitted PR1252?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only then is kappa 0.001672987659462603 an admitted finite candidate on the #1094 replay rather than a priced structural lead.
open_questions.first_step: Generalise PR1252 audit_allcold_idle_overlay.py from pair records to (centre, leaf, moved_axes) records, emit the overlay frames/template, re-pin SPEC and rerun its 15 controller and 69 assembly controls.
open_questions.blocked_by: PR1252 is unmerged; its strict-pin SPEC must be regenerated for a new profile, and the retained T16 source emission is needed.

open_questions.question: Is the per-axis commuting rule sufficient when a centre sends axes to two or three leaves, i.e. do the leaves need to commute with each other's terminal translations?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The star class is the sequential composition of PR1252-rule transfers with the donor rank relaxed below 48; soundness of that composition is inherited, not proved here.
open_questions.first_step: State the controller contract a moved idle axis must satisfy and check whether it references only donor and receiver.
open_questions.blocked_by: The PR1252 package does not state the contract beyond the pair case.

open_questions.question: Do the open X54 / mixed-T37 constructions (PR1218, PR1261, kappa 0.0016758) have unhosted idle rank-48 remainders where the same star moves apply?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The idle-repartition gain is additive in the moment and may stack on a stronger base word.
open_questions.first_step: Run analyze.py logic on their idle-remainder frames after adapting the replay paths.
open_questions.blocked_by: Different replay layouts; those candidates are unreviewed.
